rows.bname: จำนวนสตรีตั้งครรภ์ที่มารับบริการ จากแฟ้ม DIAGNOSIS_OPD และแฟ้ม ANC
rows.indiv_sql:
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF  EXISTS  t_ht_rdu ;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS  t_ht_rdu AS
SELECT
p.HOSPCODE,p.PID,p.CID, p.NAME, p.LNAME, p.SEX
,p.BIRTH, p.HID, p.addr, p.check_vhid, p.NATION, p.check_typearea
,a.gravida,a.l_bdate,a.ldiag,a.o_bdate,a.odiag,a.i_bdate,a.idiag,a.min_anc,a.max_anc
,a.min_oz,a.max_oz,a.oz_code,a.bdate,a.min_preg1,a.min_preg2
,if(SUBSTR(o.DIAGCODE,1,4) IN('Z952'),NULL,1) tcount
,d.DATE_SERV,d.DIDSTD,d.DNAME,d.AMOUNT
,IF(ISNULL(a.bdate) AND d.DATE_SERV >= a.min_preg1,1,
		IF(a.bdate is not NULL AND d.DATE_SERV BETWEEN  a.min_preg1 AND a.bdate,1,
		IF(a.bdate is not NULL AND a.min_preg2 is not NULL AND d.DATE_SERV > a.min_preg2,1,0
  ))) rcount
FROM t_rdu_anc_labor a 
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON a.HOSPCODE=p.HOSPCODE AND a.PID=p.PID
INNER JOIN chospital h ON a.hospcode=h.hoscode AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,15)
LEFT JOIN tmp_diag_opd o ON a.HOSPCODE=o.HOSPCODE AND a.PID=o.PID 
	AND o.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d  
LEFT JOIN tmp_drug_asu d ON o.hospcode=d.HOSPCODE AND o.PID=d.PID AND o.SEQ=d.SEQ 
		AND o.DATE_SERV=d.DATE_SERV AND CHK_PRG = 'Y' AND d.amount > 0 AND d.scount=1
ORDER BY rcount DESC;

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx(
SELECT d.HOSPCODE,d.PID, d.CID, d.NAME, d.LNAME, d.SEX
,d.BIRTH, d.HID, d.addr, d.check_vhid, d.NATION, d.check_typearea
,d.gravida,d.l_bdate,d.ldiag,d.o_bdate,d.odiag,d.i_bdate,d.idiag,d.min_anc,d.max_anc
,d.min_oz,d.max_oz,d.oz_code,d.bdate,d.min_preg1,d.min_preg2
,d.DATE_SERV,d.DIDSTD,d.DNAME,d.AMOUNT,d.tcount,d.rcount
,IF(d.rcount IN(1),'พบการจ่ายยา','ไม่พบประวัติ') result
FROM t_ht_rdu d  WHERE d. tcount IN(1) AND d. rcount IN(1)
GROUP BY d.HOSPCODE,d.PID
);
SELECT
h.hoscode, h.hosname, d.PID, d.CID, d.NAME, d.LNAME, d.SEX
, d.BIRTH, d.HID, d.addr, d.check_vhid, d.NATION, d.check_typearea
,d.gravida,d.l_bdate,d.ldiag,d.o_bdate,d.odiag,d.i_bdate,d.idiag,d.min_anc,d.max_anc
,d.min_oz,d.max_oz,d.oz_code,d.bdate,d.min_preg1,d.min_preg2
,d.DATE_SERV,d.DIDSTD,d.DNAME,d.AMOUNT,d.tcount,d.rcount
,d.result
FROM
tx d
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE 1=1 {where}

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("target") "target" ,SUM("result") "result"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
